data.one_liner: Provides an ImageProvider for AssetEntity from photo_manager
data.what_it_does: It wraps photo_manager's AssetEntity into a Flutter ImageProvider, allowing images to be displayed with Image widgets. It also offers a convenience widget AssetEntityImage.
use_when: You need to display photos from photo_manager in a Flutter app
You want a simple ImageProvider without custom decoding logic
avoid_when: You need advanced image caching or transformations beyond basic display
You are already using a different image provider plugin
strengths: Simple API, integrates directly with photo_manager
Provides progress handling and frame support
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, no additional permissions needed beyond photo_manager

alternatives.name: photo_manager
alternatives.why_pick_it: Handles asset selection and provides its own image widget

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows picking images from gallery but not as ImageProvider for AssetEntity
